summary: The registrant, One & One Green Technologies INC, filed a Form 6-K reporting that certain shareholders (>5% holders) voluntarily extended their lock-up agreements for six months beyond the original IPO lock-up expiration on July 9, 2026. No price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine disclosure of a voluntary lock-up extension, not a special situation like a going-private, tender offer, or activist campaign. There are no deal terms, structural changes, or risk-arb angles. The filing serves only to update the market on shareholder restrictions.
